title: Testing, CI, Containers & Operational Docs
objectives: Run the test pyramid in CI per PR

examples.name: Dockerfile
examples.code:
FROM node:22-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev

FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
USER node                       # never root
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

# CI (per PR): lint -> typecheck -> unit -> integration (test containers)
# deploy step: migrate -> health-gated rollout -> observe

exercise.prompt: Order the CI/deploy pipeline: "lint + unit tests", "docker build", "run migrations", "health-gated rollout", "observe dashboards".
hints: Fast gates first; expensive builds only for green code.
Migrations precede rollout; observation closes the loop.
